message: Exceeded %d Start blocks at block number %d
detail: The trigger model can only run a limited number of paths simultaneously. There is an implied Start block at the beginning of the model plus any user added Start blocks.

message: Exceeded %d true branch depth at block number %d
detail: The maximum true path branch depth has been exceeded. Branch depth is increased by one whenever the true path of a branch block leads to another branch block.

message: Trigger model block #%d is being executed by multiple trigger model paths
detail: A trigger model block can only be executed in one trigger model path. There is a second Start block which could follow a path to this block.

message: Block number %d must use different configuration list types
detail: When using a trigger model block with two configuration lists, the configuration lists must be of different types (for example, Measure and Source, or Measure and Switch)

message: Block number %d failed to apply configuration list index %d and %d
detail: Verify the configuration list settings are valid when used together. View the event log for more information.

message: Block number %d %s configuration list type not allowed to be followed with %s block
detail: A configuration list has a measure Function with a Digitize block or a digitize Function with a Measure block. Specify a list with a function for block defined in model or change block to match function in specified list.

message: Trigger model cannot be paused during Measure or Digitize blocks with Count Infinite
detail: Abort the trigger model and if you want to pause then change the count.

message: Trigger model pause automatically completed the last active delay block
detail: When resuming, the trigger model will continue on the next block after the delay block.

message: Trigger model cannot be resumed unless it is in the paused state
detail: Pause the trigger model before attempting to resume the trigger model.

message: Trigger model cannot be paused unless it is already running
detail: Initiate the trigger model before attempting to pause the trigger model.

message: Trigger model pause is waiting for the last measurement
detail: Wait until trigger model state changes to PAUSE. Trigger model abort will not take effect until pause is finished.

message: Unable to write to USB flash device
detail: The USB flash device is unplugged or failed. Restart scan, or pause trigger model and resume with an inserted USB flash device.

message: The fan is spinning too slowly (%d%% of minimum)
detail: The instrument is experiencing an internal malfunction and requires immediate service. Contact us at tek.com/keithley.

message: %s temperature over %d C, consider corrective action
detail: The instrument is nearing an internal temperature where corrective action will be necessary. The next limit will automatically turn off source outputs or limit other functionality.
An internal malfunction has been corrected. The instrument is now operating normally.
The instrument is operating at normal temperature levels and is fully functional.
The instrument temperature has reached a level at which source output and other functionality are not available.

message: Full functionality restored because of acceptable instrument temperature
detail: The instrument temperature has fallen to a level at which source output and other functionality are now available.
The fan may not be monitored accurately. Contact us at tek.com/keithley.
Create the configuration list through the front panel or by using a create command.

message: Configuration list does not have stored settings at index %d
detail: Use the configuration list size command to determine how many indexes are stored in the configuration list. Resend command with a valid index.

message: Invalid configuration list name parameter; the string has no characters
detail: The configuration list name cannot be blank.

message: Invalid %s configuration list name parameter; it has more than %d characters
detail: Shorten the string name to be no more than the maximum number of characters.
Use a valid string for the configuration list name parameter.

message: The %s attribute is not available for the %s function
detail: The listed attribute is not supported for the stated function. Not all attributes operate for all functions. Refer to the product documentation.

message: DMM cannot measure when %s function is set to None
detail: You cannot use the measure and digitize functions at the same time. Setting the Function of one therefore sets the Function of the other to None. Set the measure or digitize Function to a valid function and try again.

message: %s; on step %d, sub-step %d, value %f; expected value from %f to %f
detail: A measurement of an internal value was outside of the expected range. Check your connections and try again. If this issue persists, contact us at tek.com/keithley.

message: Digitize function, Aperture %g s exceeds maximum of %g s
detail: The digitize Aperture must be smaller than the period that corresponds to the Sample Rate. Reduce the Aperture or reduce the Sample Rate.

message: Turning on Dry Circuit also turned on Offset Compensation
detail: Offset compensation was automatically enabled to improve measurement accuracy.

message: Analog triggers won't operate since %s Level is %g and exceeds %s Range of %g to %g
detail: Set the analog Trigger Level to be within specified Range or select a higher fixed Range based on analog trigger and waveform levels.

message: Analog trigger %s Level of %g exceeds present %s Range of %g to %g
detail: The analog trigger event will never be detected with these settings. Set the Analog Trigger Level to be within specified range limits or select a higher fixed Range based on analog trigger and waveform levels.

message: Analog trigger is %s, Auto Range is On, %s level is %g and present Range is %g to %g
detail: Select a fixed Range that is appropriate for waveform levels and analog trigger level or ignore warning since Auto Range is On. Auto Range will change to a new range that allows analog trigger detection.
You cannot set both the Measure and Digitize functions to None. Either the Measure or Digitize Function must be set to a valid Function other than None.

message: Setting %s with invalid value for function %s
detail: Refer to the product documentation for more information.

message: %s cannot be turned on because %s is On
detail: Dry Circuit and Open Lead Detector are incompatible. Only one can be enabled at a time. If you want use one, you must first set the other to Off.

message: Cannot set Trigger Window %s to %g because %s (%g). %s Level unchanged (%g)
detail: Set the analog Trigger Window High Level to be more than the Window Low Level setting or set Low Level setting to be less than Window High Level setting.

message: Cannot set analog trigger to Window when High <= Low. High = %g and Low = %g
detail: Set the analog Trigger Window levels so that the Low Level is less than the High Level. Then, set analog Trigger to Window again.

message: Changing digitize Sample Rate to %d changed digitize Aperture to %g s
detail: The maximum Aperture is 1/(Sample Rate). The instrument automatically adjusts the Aperture setting if the Sample Rate is changed to a rate that does not support the existing Aperture setting.

message: Auto Range is not available on Rear 10 A terminal
detail: Auto Range is only available for 3 A terminal. Select a specific range.

message: Cannot sustain requested Sample Rate into reading buffer
detail: The present Sample Rate is too high to be sustained into a buffer size over 8,000,000 readings. Decrease the Sample Rate or decrease the buffer size.

message: High speed readings caused buffer overrun and readings were lost
detail: An internal issue has resulted in the loss of readings. Power cycle and restart the test sequence.

message: High speed analog buffer overrun and readings were lost
detail: An internal issue has resulted in the loss of readings. Power cycle and restart the test sequence.

message: Auto Range is not available for the rear-panel 10 A range
detail: The only Range available for the Rear 10 A terminal is 10 A. Select a lower Range (3 A or below) to select the other terminal. You can then enable Auto Range.

message: Setting %s is not used while Transducer is %s. Change Transducer to %s
detail: The change to the setting was made, but to use the setting, change the Transducer type to one that uses this setting. Set the Transducer type before setting other temperature attributes.

message: Cannot change integration rate (Aperture) when Detector Bandwidth is 3 or 30 Hz
detail: To change the integration rate (Aperture) for AC Voltage or AC Current, set the Detector Bandwidth to 300 Hz before setting the Integration Rate for these functions.

message: 10 A range is not supported on Front terminals
detail: Select the Rear terminals and the 10 A range before connecting to the 10 A terminal.

message: Threshold Level exceeds the Threshold Range
detail: The Threshold Level cannot be greater than the Threshold Range.

message: Changing the Threshold Range resulted in a change to the Threshold Level
detail: The Threshold Level cannot be above the Threshold Range. The Threshold Level was lowered to the Threshold Range value.

message: Cannot determine Relative Offset due to reading overflow
detail: The instrument is presently measuring overflow and cannot use the reading for the Relative Offset value. Change the configuration to get valid readings before attempting another relative value acquire operation.

message: Rel Offset Method set to Parts caused the Level be set to maximum of %g
detail: When the relative offset method is set to Parts, the relative offset level cannot exceed the maximum range value of the function. Change the Relative Offset level before changing the Relative Method.

message: Front terminals cannot measure on 10 A range and was changed to 3 A range
detail: The Front terminals cannot measure above 3 A. The range has been automatically changed from 10 A to 3 A. To make 10 A measurements, select the Rear terminals and change to the 10 A range.

message: Invalid %s function parameter, cannot use a %s function for %s
detail: A function command received an incorrect parameter value. Resend the command and use a measure function or a digitize function.

message: Analog triggers won't operate since %s level is %g A on Front terminals
detail: Set the analog trigger level to be less than 3 A or select Rear terminals and enable them to measure or digitize above 3 A. Then set the analog trigger levels above 3 A.
The function attribute listed was set to the indicated value because of a performance setting change. If the setting is incorrect for your application, change the setting or performance selection.

message: The internal temperature is too hot for normal specification operation
detail: Check for blocked air vents and use the unit in a cooler environment. Running at high temperature reduces measurement accuracy.

message: The internal temperature of the instrument has cooled enough
detail: Temperature allows for normal specification operation.

message: Analog trigger and measure Auto Range cannot both be enabled at the same time
detail: You will need to set the Range to a fixed value before running the trigger model that is waiting for an analog trigger event.

message: Analog trigger and Auto Zero cannot both be enabled at the same time
detail: Turn off Auto Zero and set a fixed range.

message: You cannot Auto Zero once when analog trigger is enabled
detail: Turn off analog trigger mode, then do the Auto Zero once operation.

message: Aborted high speed acquisition resulted in missing readings
detail: When you abort high-speed data acquisition, you may lose data segments. Measurements that were acquired are valid but were not acquired at the requested rate.

message: The Threshold Level must be 0 %s when threshold Auto Range is On
detail: To set a Threshold Level, select a Threshold Range, then set Threshold Level

message: Cannot set Threshold Range to Auto for %s when Threshold Level is not 0
detail: Set Threshold Level to 0 and then set Threshold Range to Auto.

message: Cannot change Auto Zero setting for %s when Detector Bandwidth setting is %d Hz
detail: Auto Zero can only be changed when detector bandwidth setting equals 300 Hz. Set Detector Bandwidth to 300 Hz then change Auto Zero setting.

message: Auto Zero for %s was turned On because the Detector Bandwidth is %d Hz
detail: Auto Zero enable is fixed at On for Detector Bandwidth settings of 3 and 30 Hz. When Detector Bandwidth setting is 300 Hz, the Auto Zero setting may be set to On or Off.

message: Analog to Digital communication packets dropped
detail: An internal issue has resulted in the loss of data. Cycle power and restart the test sequence.

message: Digital to Analog communication packets dropped
detail: An internal issue has resulted in the loss of data. Cycle power and restart the test sequence.

message: Disconnected %s stimulus for direct triggering of measurements
detail: Continuous Measurement triggers measurements and is not compatible with triggering when using the stimulus commands. The event connected to this stimulus was removed. To reconnect, use the stimulus command.

message: Analog trigger mode, Auto Zero, and Auto Range cannot be enabled at the same time
detail: Turn off Auto Zero and set a fixed Range.

message: Input Impedance for %s won't take effect until Signal Coupling is DC
detail: Input Impedance is not used for AC signal coupling. It only applies when Signal Coupling is DC. Change Signal Coupling with coupling type command.

message: For a digitize Count above %d, the Sample Rate must be below %d
detail: To use a high Sample Rate, you must decrease the digitize Count. If a high digitize Count is needed, decrease the Sample Rate.

message: The %s command is not available for the %s function
detail: The command is not supported for the function. Not all commands work for all functions. Refer to the product documentation.

message: No channels closed on card to measure
detail: When Rear terminals are selected, the channels on a card must be closed in order to make a valid measurement. Close the desired channel to measure.

detail: Internal and external reference junction is only supported on the Rear terminals.

message: Channel %s can only be set to 2-wire functions
detail: The channel can only be configured for 2-wire functions. Refer to the card documentation for more information for this channel.

message: Cannot use channel %s that is paired to a channel with a 4W function
detail: Change the function on the paired channel to a non 4-wire function. Then this channel will available for 2-wire functions.

message: Cannot set a measure attribute for a function different from the channel function
detail: Channels can only associate measure attributes from one function at a time. To set attributes for a different function, first change the channel's function to the required function.

message: Channel %s is closed to measure %s without Rear terminals selected
detail: Select the Rear terminals to measure through card channels.

message: Channel %s does not support the internal reference junction setting
detail: Verify that the card supports the setting Reference Junction to Internal.

message: Filter Type Moving or Hybrid Average not available to set on a channel
detail: The Filter Type cannot be Moving or Hybrid Average because the DMM does not keep averages per channel. Use Reading Buffer Channel Math for a method to average readings on a channel.

message: Channel %s type does not support measurement attributes
detail: Refer to the card documentation for more information for this channel.

message: Channel %s mode is invalid since digital type monitor channels must be input
detail: Use a digital input channel for monitor channel.  Also, monitor channel type may be switch or totalizer.

message: Scan initiated with Front terminals active

message: Cannot learn scan limits with Front terminals active

message: Cannot add read only channel %s to scan write step

message: %s setting can only be set to less than %d s

message: Limits on channel %s were not set while learning scan limits because of overflow

message: Existing scan was modified by another trigger model template

message: Number of measurements in the scan is greater than the buffer size
detail: Data will be lost because the buffer selected for the scan is too small to support all measurements in the scan. Increase the buffer capacity selected for the scan, or use a different buffer.

message: High limit is less than or equal to the low limit for the selected scan monitor mode
detail: If you are monitoring a range of measurements to determine when to start the scan, the high value must be greater than the low value

message: Trigger model pause delayed because USB flash device write is in progress

message: Trigger model resume failed because USB flash device is not inserted

message: Available capacity for all reading buffers exceeded, remaining capacity is %d readings
detail: The combination of all created reading buffers must not exceed the overall capacity available. Delete user buffers or shrink the default buffers to gain space.

message: Invalid size: Reading buffer capacity must be between %d and %d readings
detail: Ensure the requested capacity is between the limits given.

message: Reading buffer capacity changed failed, automatically sized to %d readings
detail: Memory for the requested capacity was unavailable. The buffer was sized to fit the memory available.

message: A default buffer cannot be deleted
detail: Only user-defined reading buffers may be deleted. You may shrink the capacity of default buffers to gain space.

message: Can only change format of reading buffer %s when empty
detail: This buffer stores attributes based on the first reading to save space. Those attributes cannot be different for future readings. Clear buffer before changing format attributes.

message: Time in a 'writable' reading buffer cannot reverse
detail: The time specified when writing to a writable buffer must move forward from the previous reading. If you do not specify a time then a valid time will be added.

message: Measurements cannot be added to a 'writable' reading buffer
detail: A 'writable' reading buffer cannot be used as a reading buffer capable of making normal measurements.

message: Reading buffer %s must be of a 'writable' style to use this function
detail: Certain functionality is only available for writable reading buffers. Create the reading buffer with the 'writable' style to enable this functionality.

message: Reading buffer, %s, does not store %s, must be at least of style %s
detail: Not all information is contained in every reading buffer style. Refer to product documentation for more information on reading buffers.

message: Requested reading count must be less than the capacity of the reading buffer
detail: The requested reading count must be less than the capacity of the reading buffer.

message: Cannot have more than %d reading buffers
detail: The total number of all user-created and default reading buffers cannot exceed the maximum indicated.

message: Reading buffer %s must be of a 'writable full' style to use extra parameters
detail: Standard writable reading buffers do not contain an extra measurement. Create the reading buffer with the writable full style to enable this functionality.

message: Cannot store readings in buffer %s, when Auto Range is On since range may change
detail: This buffer stores attributes based on first reading to save space. Those attributes cannot change once stored. Select a different buffer to store readings or set Range to a fixed value before storing readings in this buffer.

message: Invalid reading buffer statistics; start and end time parameters
detail: The start and end times must be specified as either 2 parameters; start decimal seconds and end decimal seconds, or as 4 parameters; start integer seconds, start fractional seconds, start integer seconds, and start fractional seconds.

message: Reading buffer custom unit truncated to two characters
detail: Only the first two characters of custom units are used. Change the custom unit to only use one or two characters.

message: Expression requires %d parameters but %d were supplied
detail: Refer to product documentation for more information on the expression and the available parameters.

message: Reading buffer style %s when style %s is required
detail: The reading buffer being used is not of the correct style for requested functionality.

message: Specified flag %s causes certain other flags to be ignored
detail: The specified flag causes a predefined set of flags to be used.

message: Insufficient memory for requested reading buffer capacity, %d readings available
detail: Reading buffer maximum capacity can be limited by various factors based on memory usage. Refer to product documentation for more information on reading buffers.

message: Requested reading buffer statistics are invalid
detail: To increase performance, buffer statistics were not calculated on all readings added to the buffer. Expect inaccurate statistics.

message: Reading buffer file layout %s is incompatible with 'Export to USB' writepoint %s
detail: Refer to the product documentation for valid combinations of buffer file layout and export writepoints.

message: Reading buffer '%s' was not created because the name exceeded (%d) characters
detail: Create a buffer using a shorter buffer name.
